title: Durable native DTMF source journal foundation
scope: Isolated local macOS arm64 protocol and Store libraries. Controlled native parent/source fixtures establish durable source custody, not actual signaling IO or received DTMF.
implementation: Exact dtmf.send logical identity, original payload and extensions, digit spelling, requested method and optional stream revision survive retries. Named dtmf.send permission is independent of media permission; existing credential issuance is unchanged.

Complete sequence validation precedes acceptance:1..32 ASCII telephone digits, RFC4733 duration40..6000ms or INFO100..5000ms,30second total including70ms gaps,32KiB payload. Schema83 repeats these bounds and retains all original credential/key/Device/Endpoint/member/runtime/generation/expiry source constraints.

One common journal attempt is reserved before any future engine call. Changed intent conflicts; cancellation/restart after attempt preserves original uncertainty and never resubmits. Definite no-effect refusal closes custody. A media/quality/capability/data receipt cannot complete a DTMF attempt. No DTMF success receipt or public dispatch is enabled before recipient effects are integrated.
